title: Connection
text: Sample guidance: a stable connection of at least a few Mbps is commonly suggested for video consultation.

title: Device
text: Sample guidance: a phone, tablet or computer with a working camera and microphone.

title: Environment
text: Sample guidance: a quiet, well-lit and reasonably private space for the conversation.

title: Preparation
text: Sample guidance: keep previous prescriptions, reports and a list of current medicines nearby.
